=== Day 2: the town meeting ===
Nisha: "Hollis raises a serious flag on the board. Fenwick's reading on the Docks found one evil soul in a crowd that included them."  [case board: #46]
Hollis: "So that the record is free of ambiguity on this point: I am the Martyr."
Hollis: "Last night, I have given my life over for Bartholomew, should the town ever hang them."
Hollis: "While I lack a formal proof as yet, Merrin's conduct strikes me as anomalous."  [case board: #47, #48, #49]
Bartholomew: "No sense hiding it longer. I am the Surveyor."
Bartholomew: "The night before you arrived, I learned that not everyone living on the Docks shares the same alignment."
Bartholomew: "Don't trust Lian. My own reading says the people living on the Docks aren't all on one side, and they live there."  [case board: #50, #51, #52]
Lian: "Here's what the town needs to know to narrow the list: I am the Psychologist."
Lian: "Last night, I learned that at least one of these two statements from day 1 was a lie or misreading: Fenwick's Dowser reading (night 1); or Merrin's Rumormonger reading (the night before you arrived)."
Lian: "I back Hollis's read on Merrin. I saw them out in the street from my window last night."  [case board: #53, #54, #25, #27, #55, #56]
Merrin: "Hear Bartholomew well, for I too see the shadow upon Lian!"  [case board: #57]
Nisha: "To eliminate an unnecessary unknown from the town's reasoning: I am the Warden."
Nisha: "My own reckoning agrees with Bartholomew about Lian."  [case board: #58, #59]
Constance: "In the interest of the town and proper order, I shall be plain: I am the Clerk."
Constance: "The night before you arrived, I learned that one of Nisha and Hollis is the Martyr."  [case board: #60, #61]
Agnes: "I'll not keep secrets from my neighbors when we're in such need. I am the Medium."  [case board: #62]
Odette: "Since we are doing public confessions today, let's get mine over with: I am the Night Watch."
Odette: "The night before you arrived, I watched the Docks: nobody stirred."
Odette: "Last night, I watched the Docks: I saw Constance out."
Odette: "If anyone is keeping score, I don't trust Constance. My own watch saw them out at night where someone was killed."  [case board: #63, #64, #65, #66]

Hollis: "I am compelled to question Merrin's standing. I saw them out in the street from my window last night."  [case board: #92, #49]
Merrin: "Oh, a chill runs down my spine whenever Lian passes—mark them well, neighbors!"  [case board: #57]
Lian: "Before we waste time: Last night, I learned that at least one of these two statements from day 2 was a lie or misreading: Odette's Night Watch reading (the night before you arrived); or Bartholomew's Surveyor reading (the night before you arrived)."  [case board: #93, #64, #51]
Agnes: "Oh, Last night, communing with the dead at Fenwick's hearth, I learned nothing they hadn't already told us."
Agnes: "I did see Odette out on the Docks last night."  [case board: #94, #95]
Odette: "Before you invent a grander theory: Last night, I watched the Docks: I saw Agnes out."
Odette: "Miraculously, Merrin and I are of one mind regarding Lian."  [case board: #96, #97]
Agnes: "I'm with Merrin when it comes to Lian, neighbors."  [case board: #98]
Greta: "You missed something, outsider: Last night, I learned that Constance, whom we hanged, was the Demon."  [case board: #99]
